To: jan.thornton@mailbox.example
Replying to: none
Cc: pete.thornton@mailbox.example, carol.rigby@mailbox.example
Subject: Caravan 2027 costs and weeks

Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2027 has come in at £5,087 all in, so that is £1,271.75 each between the four of us. It has gone up again, nearly £350 on last year. There is nothing I can do about it, the park sets it.

Please can you pay me by 31 January into the same account as before, as the park wants it all by then. If anyone would rather pay in two lots that is fine, £635.87 in December and £635.88 in January.

The weeks are as follows and there are no clashes this year. Carol Easter week and a week in September, let me know which week you want Carol. Pete and Linda May half term, 29 May to 5 June. Me and Bev 5 to 12 June, so we will hand over with Pete and Linda on the 5th. Jan 7th to 14th August for the grandkids.

Pete mentioned the shower tray was cracked. I went up on 26 October and put a new one in. It was £140 in parts but I am not putting it on the bill, it is done.

Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave. The park has moaned about it again.

One more thing so nobody is surprised later. The park says caravans over 15 years old need a condition survey before the 2028 season and ours is 16 year old now. I do not know what it will cost yet but I will find out and let you know.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
